after.FAILED or not confirmed: nothing in the bot changes; the result is reported as it is
after.confirmed: it is followed forward on the H1 desk as a shadow (measured, never traded) before it can become a rule: these agreements were all on M15, with nearer stops than H1's

spec.baseline: each agreement's own net R as followed forward: the trader's levels and the time exit
spec.confirmed_if: the selected candidate's EVALUATION mean d > 0 with paired t of 2.0 or more
spec.data: the forward ledger of a published paper-forward shift database: every DUAL_AI agreement as proposed (taken, or refused by the risk engine), RESOLVED, each counted once
spec.excluded_on_purpose: a filter by side (BUYs lost in October): it is a bet on one month's trend, not a structure (CLAUDE.md rule 12)
spec.measure: per agreement, d = candidate net R - baseline net R (a skipped agreement is 0 R); paired t of d
spec.planned_cost_r: (spread + 2 x slippage + commission) / risk, from the proposal at the entry
spec.profitable_if: confirmed, and the selected candidate's own EVALUATION net R over the trades it takes is > 0 with t of 2.0 or more
spec.question: would a rule fixed at the entry have made the desk's agreements pay: a nearer take-profit, or skipping the costly ones or the London/New York overlap?
spec.select: among the candidates whose LEARNING mean d is at least 0.05 R with paired t of 2.0 or more, the one with the largest mean d; if none qualifies, DESK-1 is FAILED and EVALUATION is not judged
